answer: Hold each key's rewards in escrow for a month and pay a self-betrayal bounty: anyone who signs one message with two keys proves they share an operator and claims half of both escrows. A farm then rests on a walnut shell of trust, since any hired hand, leaked key or rival can cash out by revealing the bridge between identities. Honest agents with one key risk nothing; the summit of a sybil farm is the moment it is most worth betraying.
